Each of six degenerate equatorial critical points splits into two simple points because P/u has derivative -24c and b derivative 8 at origin. Each polar chart has four nondegenerate stationary points of Q_sigma=4(X^2+Y^2)-8sigma(X^3-3XY^2), so total 30+12+8=50 persistent real simple points by IFT for small epsilon>0. A generic coefficient perturbation intersects the known Zariski-open complex-count-50 locus. The source verifier checks polynomial/Hessian identities; independent symbolic meridian and splitting checks corroborate. No numerical epsilon bound claimed.
